nodes.label: sendRevisiOE - POST /pr/cs/send-revisi-oe/{rfq_number}/{vendor_batch}
nodes.rationale: Requests an Owner Estimate revision, setting rfq_tipe = 'revisi_oe'. Requires a new item_value per item - the same field getPriceNotMatch compares against - so this is the corrective action for an OE that was set too low.

edges.source_location: requestBody example mirrors items[] + rfq_tipe shape without declaring it
